class.name: MaszynaScenarioEventServer
class.brief_description: The original's event system on [ScenarioEventServer]'s dispatcher.
class.description: Its memory cells and launchers ([code]simulation::Memory[/code], [code]TEventLauncher[/code], [code]MemCell.h[/code], [code]EvLaunch.h[/code]), the events of its tracks and isolated sections, and what an event of it is besides its delay, condition and action - waiting for its train's departure, or passive. Everything belongs to an event system ([method ScenarioEventServer.system_create]) whose implementation is this server's ([method implementation_get]), and goes when the implementation is detached from the system.

method.name: event_add_to_query
method.description: Runs [param event] at once when it is an [code]addvalues[/code] of no delay - queued, a second request before it ran would be lost - and queues any other ([method ScenarioEventServer.event_queue]), with [param activator] as the vehicle that asked. Whatever queues an event of a MaSzyna scenery goes through it. Returns whether the event was run or queued.

method.name: event_get_departure_delay
method.description: Seconds from the departure of the queueing vehicle's train [param event] runs at, NAN for none (see [method event_set_departure_delay]).

method.name: event_is_passive
method.description: Whether [param event] is never queued (see [method event_set_passive]).

method.name: event_is_queued_on_every_move
method.description: Whether [param event] goes on on every move along its track (see [method event_set_queued_on_every_move]).

method.name: event_set_departure_delay
method.description: Queued by a vehicle, the event runs [param seconds] from the departure of the vehicle's train by its timetable ([method DriverServer.vehicle_get_seconds_until_departure]), not before now, instead of from now ([code]departuredelay[/code], [code]Event.cpp:2431-2444[/code]); [code]NAN[/code] for an event that does not wait for a departure.

method.name: event_set_passive
method.description: A passive event is never queued - nothing runs it; drivers read it on the tracks ahead (the original's [code]m_passive[/code], [code]Event.cpp:2380-2384[/code]).

method.name: event_set_queued_on_every_move
method.description: A track's [code]event1[/code]/[code]event2[/code] of a delay of -1 or less goes on on every simulation step a vehicle stays on the track - the crew ones for a vehicle whose cab is occupied, the [code]all[/code] ones for any ([code]TTrack::QueueEvents(..., -1.0)[/code], [code]TrkFoll.cpp:249-260[/code]) - not only once as the vehicle comes on.

method.name: implementation_get
method.description: The implementation to attach to a MaSzyna scenery's event system ([method ScenarioEventServer.system_attach_implementation]).

method.name: isolated_add_event
method.description: Queues [param event] when the [TrackServer] isolated section [param isolated] does what [param slot] says.

method.name: launcher_attach_condition
method.description: Sets what decides whether [param launcher] fires; a null condition always passes.

method.name: launcher_create
method.description: A launcher of the [ScenarioEventServer] event [param system]; it goes when this server's implementation is detached from the system. Creates a launcher that fires nothing.

method.name: launcher_fire
method.description: Queues the event of [param launcher] if its condition passes.

method.name: launcher_fire_shift
method.description: Queues the Shift event of [param launcher] if its condition passes.

method.name: launcher_free
method.description: Frees [param launcher].

method.name: launcher_get_event
method.description: The event [param launcher] fires ([code]Event1[/code], [code]EvLaunch.h[/code]).

method.name: launcher_get_key
method.description: The key that fires [param launcher].

method.name: launcher_get_key_needs_shift
method.description: Whether the key of [param launcher] fires it only with Shift.

method.name: launcher_get_name
method.description: The scenery name of [param launcher].

method.name: launcher_get_position
method.description: Where [param launcher] stands.

method.name: launcher_get_radius
method.description: How close its user has to be to [param launcher], negative for anywhere.

method.name: launcher_get_rid_by_name
method.description: The launcher of [param name]; an empty RID for none.

method.name: launcher_get_rids
method.description: Every launcher.

method.name: launcher_get_shift_event
method.description: The event [param launcher] fires with Shift ([code]Event2[/code], [code]EvLaunch.h[/code]).

method.name: launcher_set_events
method.description: The event [param launcher] fires, and the one it fires with Shift ([code]Event1[/code], [code]Event2[/code], [code]EvLaunch.h[/code]).

method.name: launcher_set_fire_once
method.description: [param launcher] fires once, the first time it is in reach and its condition passes ([code]-10000[/code], [code]EvLaunch.cpp:182-186[/code]); it looks every second of simulated time, the original every frame.

method.name: launcher_set_interval
method.description: [param launcher] fires every [param seconds] of simulated time, 0 for never.

method.name: launcher_set_key
method.description: The key that fires [param launcher].

method.name: launcher_set_key_needs_shift
method.description: The key of [param launcher] fires it only with Shift - a key given as a capital letter's code ([code]vk_to_glfw_key()[/code], [code]EvLaunch.cpp:32-50[/code]).

method.name: launcher_set_name
method.description: The scenery name [param launcher] is found by ([method launcher_get_rid_by_name]).

method.name: launcher_set_position
method.description: Where [param launcher] stands.

method.name: launcher_set_radio_call
method.description: [param launcher] fires when a vehicle's radio sends [param call] within its radius ([code]event_manager::queue_receivers()[/code], [code]Event.cpp:2255-2268[/code]).

method.name: launcher_set_radius
method.description: How close its user has to be to [param launcher], negative for anywhere; a launcher of a radius fires only in reach of the camera ([code]scene.cpp:126-139[/code]).

method.name: launcher_set_time_of_day
method.description: [param launcher] fires when the clock shows [param hour]:[param minute], every day; [param hour] -1 for never ([code]EvLaunch.cpp:197-211[/code]).

method.name: launcher_set_train_triggered
method.description: The radius of [param launcher] is measured to the front of the player's vehicle rather than to the camera ([code]traintriggered[/code], [code]scene.cpp:129-133[/code]).

method.name: memory_add_friction_track
method.description: [param memory] modifies the friction of [param track] by its values from now on: friction * value1 + value2 (a track's [code]friction <memcell>[/code], [code]Track.cpp:924, 2527-2533, 3526[/code]).

method.name: memory_check_command
method.description: The text of [param memory] was written: whether it is a command for a driver to be sent is decided anew ([code]TMemCell::CommandCheck()[/code], [code]MemCell.cpp:52-99[/code]). Whoever writes the text calls it.

method.name: memory_command_sent
method.description: A driver sent the command of [param memory]: it is not one any more, and its [code]:sent[/code] event is queued ([code]TMemCell::StopCommandSent()[/code], [code]MemCell.cpp:196-205[/code]).

method.name: memory_create
method.description: A memory of the [ScenarioEventServer] event [param system]; it goes when this server's implementation is detached from the system. Creates a memory cell: an empty text and both values 0.

method.name: memory_dump
method.description: Every memory cell as a problem report shows it, in the order they were made: [code]name[/code], [code]text[/code], [code]value1[/code], [code]value2[/code] and [code]track[/code], the name of the track it stands at (empty for none). [MaszynaPlugin] gives it in its [method ReloadedPlugin.dump_state] as [code]memory_cells[/code].

method.name: memory_free
method.description: Frees [param memory].

method.name: memory_get_name
method.description: The scenery name of [param memory].

method.name: memory_get_position
method.description: Where [param memory] stands.

method.name: memory_get_rid_by_name
method.description: The memory of [param name]; an empty RID for none.

method.name: memory_get_text
method.description: The text [param memory] holds.

method.name: memory_get_track
method.description: The track [param memory] stands at; an empty RID for none.

method.name: memory_get_value1
method.description: The first value [param memory] holds.

method.name: memory_get_value2
method.description: The second value [param memory] holds.

method.name: memory_has_command
method.description: Whether the text of [param memory] is a command for a driver not sent yet.

method.name: memory_set_name
method.description: The scenery name [param memory] is found by ([method memory_get_rid_by_name]).

method.name: memory_set_position
method.description: Where [param memory] stands - sent with its command to the drivers it reaches.

method.name: memory_set_sent_event
method.description: The event queued when the command of [param memory] is sent ([code]<memory>:sent[/code], [code]MemCell.cpp:265[/code]).

method.name: memory_set_track
method.description: The track [param memory] stands at ([code]TMemCell::Track[/code], [code]MemCell.h:76[/code]).

method.name: memory_set_values
method.description: Sets the text and both values of [param memory]; the tracks whose friction it modifies follow, and [signal memory_values_changed] is emitted.

method.name: track_add_event
method.description: The binding goes when the implementation is detached from the event's system. Queues [param event] when a vehicle does what [param slot] says on the [TrackServer] [param track].

method.name: track_get_events
method.description: The events of [param track] in [param slot].

method.name: track_is_velocity_changing
method.description: Whether an event changes the speed of [param track] (see [method track_set_velocity_changing]).

method.name: track_set_velocity_changing
method.description: Marks [param track] as one whose speed [param event], a [code]trackvel[/code] one, changes. A driver reading the way keeps such a track whatever its speed and reads the speed again on every update. The mark goes with the event's system.

method.name: vehicle_put_command
method.description: An order put to [param vehicle], which nobody drives ([code]TMoverParameters::PutCommand()[/code], [code]Event.cpp:808-816[/code], [code]lua.cpp:293-294[/code]): it takes the place of the order waiting and is carried out until it is done. [code]Load=[/code] and [code]UnLoad=[/code] go through the vehicle's load exchange ([method RailVehicleServer.load_add], [method RailVehicleServer.load_remove]) while it stands within the reach of [param position] - 10 m, or [param value2] when it is more than 1 ([code]Mover.cpp:12658-12694[/code]); any other order the vehicle carries out itself, again on every step.

signal.name: memory_values_changed
signal.description: The text or the values of [param memory] were set.
